headline: Klabin stock drops 6% despite third-quarter earnings exceeding analyst forecasts
summary: Brazilian paper maker Klabin saw its stock drop 6% after reporting a third-quarter net profit of R$ 393 million. Though profit fell 18% year-over-year, it beat analyst estimates.
why: Klabin is Brazil's largest paper producer and exporter, heavily exposed to global pulp pricing and export container demand.

impacts.name: Klabin S.A.
impacts.why: An 18% year-over-year earnings drop sparked investor selling despite beating estimates.

why_moved: Investor dissatisfaction with year-over-year earnings contractions overshadowed the earnings beat.
